notes: v0.83.0 (versionCode 120) — CI android-release run 39613034950 from main at 3bdf34bc. THE NEXLY REFERENCE REDESIGN + 540-ICON SET. (0) Expanded GsIcons to 540 curated Lucide glyphs (scripts/gs-icon-stems.txt), every one an opaque tintable stroke. (1) Fixed the whole-family invisible-icon defect: all icon strokes had been transparent (Color.Unspecified, alpha 0), so Icon(tint=…) recoloured nothing; now opaque and every icon renders across the drawer, settings, chat and nav. (2) Fixed interactive-artifact taps: the chat message column wrapped charts/widgets/code in one SelectionContainer whose gesture beat each datum's pointer input; selection now wraps prose only, so a bar/slice/point resolves to its value. (3) Rebuilt Home to the reference sheet — Nexly brand lockup, glass quick-action pills (New Chat / Explore / Create / More), the Video / Mind Guide / Today's reflection bento, Today's Used, and a floating glass dock. (4) Rebuilt the drawer — brand header + close, the seven destinations with glass icon tiles, account footer. (5) Rebuilt the Settings hub to the reference groups with the Nexly identity card. (6) Aligned the welcome/onboarding flow to the sheets' copy + brand. (7) Chat shows the reference Thinking / Reasoning / Effort pre-answer card, gone the instant the first token lands. Release build verified: not-debuggable, single R8 dex, baseline profile packaged, shipping cert, public origin baked in. versionCode 120 installs over 119 without uninstalling.
knownLimitations: Reference parity is in progress on the remaining surfaces: the chat sub-sheets (chat menu, quick actions, mentions, chat info), and the deeper settings pages (AI intelligence, model details, memory, voice, accessibility) still need the sheet-by-sheet pass. Home, drawer, settings hub, welcome and the chat pre-answer card are done.

The custom icon set is growing toward the reference's full set; the reference-specific icons (Sparkles, Play, House, Menu, MoreHorizontal) were added, but the ~500-icon glass family and the illustration pass are ongoing.

Per-datum interactivity is wired for the common charts (bar/line/pie/etc.); the advanced charts in WidgetsCharts3 (Sankey, Sunburst, Network, Force, Wordcloud, Violin, Contour, Parallel, Dendrogram, etc.) still need their tap routing completed against the ChartProbe contract.

iOS parity compiles on real Xcode (device + simulator builds green) but the ios-native job still stops at its XCTests step on the synchronous 0.5B model load (GsChatUiTests) exceeding the suite budget on the simulator — a pre-existing native-test/environment condition, not a build break.
OpenRouter keypool remains wiped (platform wipe). Sends serve via the z-ai fallback route until the operator re-supplies keys: bun scripts/provision-keys.ts "key1,key2,..."
stable-diffusion is disabled on mobile; libgs_sd.so is not shipped. Tesseract OCR is not in the APK; ML Kit is used instead.
